title: Aliases and back-links for agents/agent-memory-services (Durable Objects, Claude Managed Agents)
goal: _tools/aliases.csv holds the rows 'durable object,durable objects', 'durable objects,durable objects', 'managed agents,claude managed agents' and 'claude managed agents,claude managed agents', and the Reference sections of kb/public/agents/foundry-agent-service.md and kb/public/agents/shared-state-concurrency.md name agents/agent-memory-services.md

run: import csv,pathlib,sys; r={tuple(x) for x in csv.reader(open('_tools/aliases.csv',encoding='utf-8'))}; w={('durable object','durable objects'),('durable objects','durable objects'),('managed agents','claude managed agents'),('claude managed agents','claude managed agents')}; l=all('agents/agent-memory-services.md' in pathlib.Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in ('kb/public/agents/foundry-agent-service.md','kb/public/agents/shared-state-concurrency.md')); sys.exit(0 if w<=r and l else 1)
